provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
story: From Kabul it runs 348 km to Kabul; allow about 6 h of riding. The stops in between: Kakrak Valley caves including the niche of, Shahr-i-Ghulghulah, Cultural Landscape and Archaeological Rema and Bamiyan Cliff including niches of the 38 m. The highest point is about 3,400 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
